trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no separate task: this is the final reward for completing everything else in the list. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you start the game. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the first chapter's missions; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Finish every mission in the second chapter and the trophy unlocks at its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Finish every mission in the third chapter and the trophy unlocks at its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish every mission in the fourth chapter and the trophy unlocks at its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story's last mission to close the campaign and this gold unlocks. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. Play the Breakfast Run story mission through to its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Play the Cartel Heist story mission through to its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Play the Child's Play story mission through to its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Play the Headliners story mission through to its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Play the VCIA Takedown story mission through to its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Play the Operation Savage Glory story mission through to its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. Work through the in-game 100% checklist: story, collectibles, activities and side content all count. This is the longest grind in the game and the last trophy most players earn. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 Stunts. Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near-misses and airtime all count. Spread them across the map instead of repeating one spot, and they will add up as you play. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample every activity type the game offers at least once: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range and more. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 Shooting Range challenges; score gold on each one. Practise the weapon types you are weakest with first. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each Top Fun drone race spot and win the race there. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win 20 distinct races across Leonida; each race only counts once, so vary the events you enter. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to its end. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's mission strand through to its last mission. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its last mission. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand through to its last mission. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Find and finish eight stranger mission strands scattered across Leonida. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand through to its last mission. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its last mission. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots; visit and meditate at each one. The Chapter 1 spot at Jason's house / Lucia's balcony disappears after Chapter 1, so meditate there before finishing the chapter, and keep manual saves. This is the only trophy reported as possibly missable. Source: planetgta6.com / KeenGamer / PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track down and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect the cards scattered across Leonida and finish three full sets. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Finish 50 challenges of any kind across the game. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level active throughout. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and enter 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus and defeat five enemies before it ends. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the VCIA airport in an unscheduled way: take off without following the normal departure. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Deal with the Rhino tanks when they show up: the description is a joke about the heat, so expect a tank encounter. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Slip into a jewelry store, take the goods, and get out without any guard or camera spotting you. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Crack five bank vaults and escape cleanly after each one. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck, take its cargo, and escape. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of Leonida until the map is fully revealed. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find and rob one illegal operation for each of the gangs operating in Leonida. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact bar and trigger are unconfirmed: no guide has published verified steps yet, so this entry does not guess. Source: planetgta6.com; method unconfirmed (KeenGamer).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact showroom and what counts as the classic-style escape are unconfirmed: no guide has published verified steps yet. Source: planetgta6.com; method unconfirmed (KeenGamer).
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This unlocks through a partnership moment with your partner; the description is deliberately vague, so play the story and side content with your partner. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make choices in the story; the game tracks them toward this trophy. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is unconfirmed: the description hints at succeeding on a second try, but no guide has published verified steps yet. Source: planetgta6.com; method unconfirmed (KeenGamer).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trigger is unconfirmed: the description points to witnessing something strange, but no guide has published verified steps yet. Source: planetgta6.com; method unconfirmed (KeenGamer).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact method is unconfirmed: it involves knocking someone down with a melee drive-by, but no guide has published verified steps yet. Source: planetgta6.com; method unconfirmed (KeenGamer).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until you have cleaned $250,000. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend a total of $100,000 in shops across Leonida. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available in the game. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own or find to the Scooter Bros app. Source: planetgta6.com / Exophase.
trophies.name: On the Spot
